title: trial_header v1 — WIRE_FORMAT.md trial record header
description: A trial whose header cannot name its seed, SHA, and sweep point is not a result; it is an anecdote. sweep_point carries every INTERFACE_SPEC §9/§9.1 axis value for this trial. solver (optional in schema, always written by the harness) records the PHASE1_PARAMETERS #33 convergence-procedure values per run.

seed.description: single RNG root; all streams derive from it

code_git_sha.description: repo commit the harness ran from

instance.description: Compute-instance identity (ARCH §5; D-046(f), additive v1 revision like false_capture). Optional: pre-D-046 records lack it. class is a stable label (e.g. 'c7i.8xlarge', 'darwin-arm64') — byte-identity is a per-instance-class contract (R01 F-018).

params_ref.description: path to the committed parameter file

solver.description: #33: solver timestep/stiffness values logged per run
